items.label: B1
items.promptEn:
<보기> He can help you. + I think it.
→ I think that he can help you.

The story is true. + I know it.
→ I know ________________________________.
accept: I know that the story is true.

items.label: B2
items.promptEn:
She likes my present. + I hope it.
→ I hope ________________________________.
accept: I hope that she likes my present.
